preconditions.description: The number of requests n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(name) <= 32 for name in requests)
preconditions.description: Each request name has a length between 1 and 32 characters inclusive.
Each request name consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The number of responses is equal to the number of requests.

postconditions.expression: all(response == 'OK' or (response.startswith(requests[i]) and response[len(requests[i]):].isdigit()) for i, response in enumerate(responses))
postconditions.description: Each response is either 'OK' or a new name formed by appending a number to the requested name.

postconditions.expression: all(response == 'OK' or response not in requests[:i] for i, response in enumerate(responses))
postconditions.description: If a response is a new name, it has not been requested before.

postconditions.expression: all(response == 'OK' or response not in responses[:i] for i, response in enumerate(responses))
postconditions.description: If a response is a new name, it has not been generated before.
